# Pack: cmssw-releases

The CMSSW release catalog, from the public cms-bot releases.map.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | none |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cms-comp-ops`](../bundles/cms-comp-ops.md), [`cms-physics`](../bundles/cms-physics.md)
- Optional in: none

Add it to an instance with `archi add cmssw-releases`.

## Sources

- `cmssw-releases.cmssw_releases`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer cmssw_releases_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `releases_map_url` | `string` | no | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cms-sw/cms-bot/master/releases.map` | URL of the CMSSW releases.map to fetch |
